source_note: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散
english_source_note: Competing Decreasing Sequences and Series Divergence
callout_id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#7
statement_en:
Let $\alpha_n,\beta_n$ be nonnegative nonincreasing real sequences such that both series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n$ and $\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n$ diverge. Assume moreover that there exists a positive real number $c$ such that for all sufficiently large $n$,
$$2^n\beta_{2^n}\geq c >0.$$ Then the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$ diverges.
callout_body: $\alpha_n,\beta_n$是一个非负不增的实数列，并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n,\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n$均发散，此外存在一个正实数$c$对于足够大的$n$都有$$2^n\beta_{2^n}\geq c >0$$那么级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$发散
